title: Judge becomes a blocking close door for standard and high-risk routes
action: In bee close doors: when the closing feature route lane is standard or high-risk, every capped behavior_change cell must carry a judge record (see cells judge-record storage — find the trace/store field it writes). Missing records make a blocking door judge-debt whose detail lists the offending cell ids and whose command names bee cells judge / bee cells judge-record. Other lanes: door absent (not merely non-blocking). Dry-run shows it like existing doors. Tests: standard-lane feature with unjudged behavior_change cell blocks and names it, judged one passes, tiny lane never grows the door.

truths: Door exists only for standard/high-risk routes
Detail names each unjudged cell id
Remedy command is stated in the door

trace.outcome: Add a judge-debt close door for standard/high-risk routes; unjudged capped behavior_change cells refuse close, judge-on-smell lanes never grow the door
